name: Riso print flicker
looks: The same short headline flashes through four or five different two-colour ink combinations in rapid succession, as if a print were recalibrating its registration, before settling on the final colourway and holding.
build: One DOM card with a textured background (diagonal stripe or halftone dot) and a headline on top. Hard-swap, never crossfade, both the background's two spot colours and the type's ink colour together every 0.15-0.25 s through a short fixed palette list; hold the final combination at least 3x as long as a flicker step.
sound: A fast paper-flutter or shutter-click rattle through the flicker, landing on a single thunk as it settles.
prompt: Flash a short, confident headline through four or five quick ink-colour swaps on a textured print-like background, as if the press were still finding registration, then settle hard on one final colourway and hold it. Keep every swap a hard cut, never a fade.
